messages:
Zoe (People Ops): Heads-up: we've published two related handbook updates this AM: 'Whistleblower & Reporting' and 'Privacy & EU Data Handling'. Both require a short acknowledgement and a targeted privacy micro-training for employees in EMEA. Please review and action. Link: https://redwood.internal/handbook/whistleblower-privacy.

Kenji (Security): Quick Q: is the privacy micro-training replacing the broader Cybersecurity Awareness module or additive?

Zoe (People Ops): Additive. Cybersecurity Awareness stays company-wide. The privacy micro-training (~12 mins) is specific to EMEA roles and people who process personal data. It will be auto-assigned by location tag in HR.

Lina (Legal): For GDPR audit readiness we need: acknowledgement exports with user, ack_id, timestamp, location, and a note if the person is data processor or controller. Also require a consent checkbox for recording role-level data handling agreements.

Zoe (People Ops): Noted. Exports will include those fields. We'll store quarterly in the compliance bucket with 2-year retention.

Priya (Talent): How should recruiters surface this to candidates for EMEA roles?

Zoe (People Ops): Offer template: include a short line "Role requires completion of Privacy Micro-Training within 30 days if hired" for EMEA offers. Recruiting, enable auto-assign on start.

Onboard Bot: automated: Acknowledgement tasks created: 'Whistleblower Policy Acknowledgement' (all staff) and 'EMEA Privacy Micro-Training (if applicable)'. Due: 1752825600. Link: https://lms.redwood.internal/acknowledgements

Kenji (Security): Also flag: managers should include training status in the mid-cycle performance checklists for anyone in customer-data roles. We had a gap in last year's audit.

Zoe (People Ops): Added to manager checklist and created a manager tracking sheet (edit access): https://sheets.redwood.internal/whistleblower-privacy-2026. CSV header for quick import:

```
manager,employee_email,employee_id,location,status,completed_at,training_type,notes
```

Priya (Talent): For contractors in EMEA on short SOWs (<30 days) — do they get the micro-training?

Lina (Legal): Short SOW contractors who do not process personal data are exempt. If they touch personal data, assign training and capture their consent in contracting metadata.

LMS Bot: automated: Module assigned: 'Privacy Micro-Training (EMEA)' to 67 users flagged by location. Due: 1752825600. Progress: 0%. Link: https://lms.redwood.internal/course/privacy-emea-2026

Kenji (Security): Can People Ops run a one-off export now listing who will be auto-assigned so managers can pre-notify their teams?

Zoe (People Ops): Yes 1 will run and post a pre-assignment CSV to the sheet by EOD today. Managers, please review and flag any incorrect locations.

Lina (Legal): Also request: keep a log of approved extension requests with reason for audit. Use the HR ticket system only 1 will need the ticket IDs at export time.

Zoe (People Ops): Agreed. All extensions via HR ticket. We'll include ticket ids in the export.

Priya (Talent): I'll update offer templates and notify hiring partners.

Kenji (Security): Thanks. One more ask: add a column in the manager sheet for 'perf_cycle_flag' so we can mark who needs review for compliance during calibration.

Zoe (People Ops): Done. Column name: perf_cycle_flag. Please only mark true for roles that process customer or personal data.

Priya (Talent): Great. I'll remind hiring managers in the weekly sync.

Zoe (People Ops): Closing loop 1 handbook link again: https://redwood.internal/handbook/whistleblower-privacy. Ping me if you need the export format or bulk extension list.
